name: nv-formation
description: Form a Nevada LLC or corporation in 2026, step by step on the Secretary of State's ORION portal. Covers articles of organization USD 75 (NRS 86.561), articles of incorporation from USD 75 scaled to the value of authorized shares with par below 0.1 cent counted as 0.1 cent (NRS 78.760), the initial and annual list (LLC USD 150; corporation USD 150 initial, annual scaled to stock up to USD 11,125), the State Business License (USD 500 corporations, USD 200 other entities, NRS 76.100 and 76.130), expedite fees, default, revocation and the USD 300 reinstatement fee, the NRS 86.401 charging order, series under NRS 86.296, and Nevada spendthrift trusts under NRS 166. Trigger on "form a Nevada LLC", "Nevada corporation", "Nevada business license", "initial list", "annual list", "Nevada asset protection".
